summary: Tested new Admin Metrics module (backend + frontend) and anonymous /api/support-page/view. All new metrics functionality is working: 403 privacy gate on admin endpoints, anonymous counter without user_id, valid days validation, backfill validation, and full UI (7 subtabs, all KPIs/charts/CSV buttons/tables). Regression across the app is clean.
